narrative.overview: Майсторко is drawn from the yellow wooden folding carpenter's rule (сгъваем метър) that lives in every Bulgarian craftsman's back pocket. The product answers three questions, who can, how much, when free, and the rule answers the third one visually: every craftsman carries a graduated strip of the next 14 days, hinged at seven, with free days inked green and busy days left bare yellow. Time is measured like a job.
keyCharacteristics: A 14-day folding rule on every craftsman (catalog rows, profile, dashboard, calendar editor).
Yellow is a field, not an accent. Red is reserved for "today" and the date marker.
Extra-condensed numerals for dates and prices; Sofia Sans for everything else.
Hairline-ruled lists and indexes instead of card grids.
Flat surfaces with ambient shadows only on hover and overlays.

rules.name: The Yellow Field Rule
rules.body: Yellow owns whole regions (a band, a strip, a rule), never a scatter of small accents. If yellow appears as a thin decoration, it should be ink instead.

rules.name: The Measuring Mark Rule
rules.body: Red marks position in time ("today", the chosen date, the active tab), never emphasis or error. Errors use Danger, which is a separate token.

rules.name: The Green Means Free Rule
rules.body: Green appears only when it says someone is available, or when an action succeeded.

rules.name: The Printed Numeral Rule
rules.body: Any number a client compares (price, date, rating, count) is set in the condensed numerals style, never in body weight.

rules.name: The No Kicker Rule
rules.body: Headings speak for themselves: no eyebrows or small tracked labels above them.

rules.name: The One Graduation Rule
rules.body: One day is the same visual unit everywhere: one rule cell with a long tick at its left, a half tick in the middle, the numeral, then an ink bar for free or a hatched bar for partial.

rules.name: The No Block Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows always have blur and offset. Hard offset shadows are not part of this world.

dos: Do show the 14-day rule wherever a craftsman appears in a list.
Do set prices and dates in the condensed numerals style (tabular).
Do give yellow whole regions: bands, strips and fields.
Do keep tap targets at 44px or more and calendar actions reachable with one thumb.
Do label demo imagery "Демо изображение" until real photos exist.
donts: Don't use red for emphasis or errors. Red marks time only.
Don't build card grids of icon, heading and text. Use ruled lists and indexes.
Don't put eyebrows or kickers above headings.
Don't use a cream ground or a serif display. The ground is concrete paper, and the voice is Sofia Sans.
Don't use hard offset shadows, gradients as decoration, or glassmorphism.
